title: Choose the visual direction
question: The app's workflows remain; this choice sets the visual system and page expression. Keep the assigned direction, choose an alternative, use the standard product-app direction, or ask for another hand.

options.label: Transit wayfinding
options.thesis: Make network relationships and check health legible as a wayfinding system, without pretending IPs are geographic places.
options.viewport: A familiar app shell leads with Start monitoring, then a relationship-only network path and a readable check table; the current result is marked on its route line.
options.risk: Route lines could imply geography; label them as relationships and keep explicit check names beside them.

raised.raise: Use a clear, stable type hierarchy; live diagnostics never make type itself move.
Keep timestamps and repeated observations aligned in time, without encoding elapsed time as a fake map distance.
Keep each check's real name and target visible; status never replaces identity.
The topology diagram represents explicit network relationships only, never physical location.

options.label: Technical reference diagrams
options.lineage: Technical standards and network reference publications
options.thesis: Treat the host snapshot and each check as a precise reference document: compact, labeled, and easy to verify.
options.viewport: A standard navigation shell frames a readable resolution-path diagram above a dense but calm table; Start monitoring and Run once stay visible in the header.
options.risk: Reference-document density can become cramped; preserve generous section spacing and plain labels.

options.label: Live departure board
options.lineage: Passenger departure boards and boarding documents
options.thesis: Make fresh observations and changed results easy to notice in time order.
options.viewport: A standard dashboard shell puts run controls above a time-aware checks table; a changed row holds a meaningful highlight until its next observation.
options.case: Strong for scanning live changes and monitoring chronology; less distinctive for the machine-topology task.
options.risk: Travel language can mislead; borrow update behavior and tabular rhythm, not airport terminology.

options.label: Friendly consumer app
options.thesis: Make the next action and each result's meaning unusually easy to understand.
options.viewport: The dashboard offers one clear start action, a plain-language readiness state, and a simple results table; advanced configuration stays in Settings.
options.case: Holds product clarity through plain language and reduced cognitive load; weaker audience identification and visual distinctiveness.
options.risk: Can feel generic and soften important warning/failure states if status contrast is too subtle.

options.label: Variable font specimen
options.thesis: Make typography itself the interactive centerpiece.
options.viewport: The result data remains secondary to a font-axis demonstration.
options.case: Fuses poorly: type manipulation does not help the operator start or interpret diagnostics.
options.kept: Use type scale and tabular figures to make state and measurement easy to scan.
options.risk: The demo would compete with diagnostics for attention.

options.label: Labanotation score
options.thesis: Encode actions and their duration in a spatial score.
options.viewport: The dashboard becomes a vertical notation staff rather than a familiar diagnostic interface.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the notation is unfamiliar and would make check statuses harder to decode.
options.kept: Align timestamps and repeated observations so changes over time remain understandable.
options.risk: Requires learning an unrelated symbol vocabulary.

options.label: Character goods catalog
options.thesis: Present each check as a personality-led character in a ranked collection.
options.viewport: A ranked mascot grid replaces the live run controls and check table.
options.case: Fuses poorly: personality and popularity are not part of this product's job.
options.kept: Keep target and check identity visible next to every state.
options.risk: Decorative character metaphors can trivialize real connectivity failures.

options.label: Zoo guide map
options.lineage: Folded visitor maps and garden guides
options.thesis: Divide the interface into bold, swelling regions connected by coastlines.
options.viewport: Network areas become map-like regions that imply spatial position.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the data describes logical relationships, not a geographic map.
options.kept: Make topology relationships explicit and provide a clear legend.
options.risk: A visitor map suggests physical location the app does not know.

canonCard.label: Standard diagnostic dashboard
canonCard.thesis: A polished, familiar operations interface with navigation, run controls, topology, and readable tables.
canonCard.viewport: Start and Run once in the header, network summary above recent checks, conventional Environment, Logs, Summary, and Settings pages.
canonCard.risk: Familiarity may make the tool feel interchangeable with other dashboards.
